_: Listening notes on the BASILISK SYNTH 1.2.0 demo renders (best of up to four takes each; XP renders are not bit-identical run to run). 'drop' removes an automatic flag that listening showed to be a false alarm; 'note' is shown on the page.

chord-thump.note: Silent in 1.2.0: after << the position is at the start, so ] (Delete After Current Position) deletes the whole sound and the layer is empty. Silent in all four takes. BASILISK 16 1.2.1 changed this preset.

critical-bass.note: Only 3 or 4 of the 16 notes sound in every take: critstop slowed four times by << has a long quiet lead-in, so short notes end before they sound. BASILISK 16 1.2.1 trims it (@t40[).

glass-steps.note: Its quietest notes (velocity 84 on a soft, short-envelope sound) barely sound; 8 of 10 note onsets were clearly heard in the best of four takes.

click-harp.note: A quiet preset; one of its 32 arpeggio notes was not clearly heard in the best of four takes.

recycle-perc.note: A quiet preset; 2 of its 26 hits were not clearly heard in the best of four takes.

macro-echoes.note: Macro 1 steps the echo count (N), so Windows rebuilds the recorders; chords that land during a rebuild are dropped (3 of 8 in every one of four takes).

macro-layers.note: One of its 8 chords was not clearly heard in the best of four takes (Macro 1 moves the layers' levels and the second layer's offset).

logoff-strings.note: A quiet preset: about -46 LUFS before the demo's levelling.

hardware-sub.note: A quiet preset: about -45 LUFS before the demo's levelling.

print-spooler.note: A quiet preset: about -40 LUFS before the demo's levelling.
